hemomancy.zealot.plea.line1: §7[The Zealot regards you with silver eyes]
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line2: You carry the stain of the Hematic Covenant upon your blood, Votary...
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line3: But it is not too late. The hemolytic rites can cleanse what the Order has corrupted.
hemomancy.zealot.plea.line4: Bring hemolytic solution to our podium, and begin the path of the Unstained. Abandon the crimson veil before it consumes you.
hemomancy.zealot.already_on_path: You walk the path of purification. Continue your work at the podium, and the stain shall lift.
hemomancy.zealot.too_early: You do not yet know the weight of what you carry. Return when the Covenant has shown you its true face.
hemomancy.zealot.no_blood: You bear no mark of the crimson arts. Walk in peace, untouched one.
hemomancy.zealot.uninitiated: The silver bells toll only for those who have tasted the crimson. You are unburdened.

hemomancy.unstained.purity_complete: Your blood is cleansed. You are pure. Seek the Rite of Clarity.
hemomancy.unstained.clarity_unlocked: The copper resonates with your purified blood. The old ways fall silent. Clarity dawns.
hemomancy.unstained.clarity_progress: Clarity: %.0f/100 — The path to enlightenment sharpens...
hemomancy.unstained.enlightened: You have achieved Enlightenment. You are Unstained.
hemomancy.unstained.not_ready: You are not yet ready. The Hematic Covenant demands more of you before you may choose.
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_weakene: Your purifying blood resists the manipulation...
hemomancy.unstained.manipulation_blocked: Your purified blood refuses to obey.
hemomancy.altar.not_on_path: The altar is silent. Only those who walk the Unstained path may hear its call.
hemomancy.altar.lore: §7A cool mist rises from the stone... You sense the presence of Our Lady of Still Waters.
hemomancy.altar.already_blessed: The altar has already bestowed its blessing upon you. Our Lady's tears flow only once.
hemomancy.altar.blessed: §bThe Tears of Silthmere wash over the altar. A silver light floods your veins — Our Lady's blessing purifies you.
hemomancy.altar.wreath_offered: §7The lethean poppies wilt upon the altar, their essence drawn into the stone. Purity rises.
hemomancy.altar.chalice_offered: §bThe silver chalice rings with a pure tone. Clarity deepens.
hemomancy.altar.clarity_not_unlocked: The chalice resonates, but you have not yet unlocked clarity.
hemomancy.altar.icon_offered: §bThe Pallid Icon blazes with silver fire upon the altar. A flood of clarity surges through you.
hemomancy.altar.icon_already_offered: The altar has already accepted a Pallid Icon from you. Its power flows only once.
hemomancy.altar.brew_offered: §7The Lethean Brew is consumed by the altar's flame. Memories fade, and purity grows.
hemomancy.silver_bells.not_on_path: The pale silver bells do not answer you.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_pure: The bells toll softly. Your purification is already complete.
hemomancy.silver_bells.already_rung: The pale silver bells are quiet now; their blessing has already been spent.
hemomancy.silver_bells.chimed: §bThe pale silver bells ring across the sky. A great wave of purity floods your blood.

unstained.hemomancy.purity.cleansing.des: A steady purification burns away corruption.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.absolved.desc: Most traces of hemomancy have been cleansed.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.purified.desc: The blood runs silver — fully purified.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.awakened.des: The mind stirs, free from blood-haze.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.resolute.des: An unbreakable will shields against corruption.

hemomancy:components/blood_loss.descript: Applies the Blood Loss effect, slowing the target's movement. Composable with any MnA shape and modifier.
hemomancy:components/blood_rush.descript: Applies the Blood Rush effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, and minor healing. Composable with any MnA shape.
hemomancy:components/hemolysis.descripti: Applies Hemolysis, a damaging effect that destroys the target's blood over time. Composable with AoE shapes for area denial.
hemomancy:components/blood_to_mana.descr: Drains the target's blood volume and converts it into mana for the caster. The inverse of Sanguine Transmutation.
hemomancy:components/summon_sanguilith.d: Summons a Sanguilith at the target location. Requires Harbinger faction membership. Duration and damage scale with spell attributes.
hemomancy:components/blood_binding.descr: Roots the target in place, preventing movement. Duration and magnitude scale with spell attributes.
hemomancy:components/mana_to_blood.descr: Converts the caster's mana into blood volume for the target. Useful for refilling blood pools using arcane energy.

hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.not_int: I have no interest in your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.option.accept_: I wish to join your church.
hemomancy.dialogue.zealot.reject_respons: Then walk your crimson road, Votary. But know that the stain deepens with every rite you perform.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_church: The Zealot nods solemnly. 'Seek the silver bells. They will guide you.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help: The Zealot watches you turn away, silver eyes dimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.accept_purifica: The Zealot's eyes brighten. 'The podium awaits. Bring hemolytic solution and begin.'
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line1: §7[A hooded figure stirs from the shadows, its crimson eyes settling upon you with ancient patience]
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line2: At last... another wanderer finds these halls. I am the Harbinger Hermit — the last keeper of this threshold. It has been my life's sole duty to welcome those who would walk the path of blood.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line3: This heart before you — §cthe Mortal Display§r — it is mine. I offer it freely, for it was always meant to be claimed. Take it, and let the crimson tide awaken within you.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.heart_lore: The Mortal Display is a vessel of living blood, preserved since the first age of the Hematic Covenant. When you claim it, the blood within will answer to your will. It will bind itself to your veins and awaken what has long been dormant. §oThis is the first step — there is no turning back.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line1: I was placed here by the Archons of old, tasked with a single purpose: to stand vigil until a worthy soul arrived. Every Harbinger Hermit before me served the same oath — to guard the heart and guide the newcomer.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line2: When you claim the heart, my duty will be fulfilled. I will have nothing left to give but the knowledge of what comes next. §oDo not mourn what must end — the blood demands new vessels, not old keepers.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line1: §7[The Hermit's eyes widen, a trembling smile crossing its gaunt face]
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line2: You have done it... the blood stirs within you now. I can feel it — raw and untamed, but §calive§r. The Mortal Display has chosen you, and the Hematic Covenant recognizes your awakening.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line3: My vigil is nearly complete. But before I depart, let me set you upon the true path.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.guidance: Seek a place of power — a cardinal altar. Arrange the sacred blocks in the pattern of the Rite of Sanguine Initiation. I leave you my final gift: blueprints etched in blood, so that you may perform the rite and earn your first degree. The path of the Harbinger begins here.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.farewell.li: §7[The Hermit's form flickers, its body growing translucent as crimson light bleeds from its chest]
It is done. My heart is yours, my duty fulfilled. Walk the path of blood without fear — the Covenant will guide you where I cannot. §4Farewell, young Harbinger.
hemomancy.hermit.temple_lore: These temples were raised by the first Archons, long before the Order fractured. Every stone is soaked in ancient blood. The walls remember what the world has forgotten.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line2: Neophyte. You have taken the first step through the Crimson Veil. The blood recognizes you now.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.hint: Your next step lies in the Rite of the Votary. Gather your strength, prepare your altar, and prove your devotion to the Covenant. The blood demands commitment.
hemomancy.hermit.manip_lore: Blood manipulations are the voice of your hemomancy. Each one shapes the crimson tide within you. Learn them, equip them at a Mnemonic Reliquary, and let your blood speak.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line2: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. You have proven your dedication. The blood flows deeper now.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.hint: Explore the blood tendencies — Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, and more. Each shapes the nature of your manipulations. Seek the Rite of the Scarlet Sanctum when you are ready to advance.
hemomancy.hermit.tendency_lore: Every manipulation carries a tendency — a flavor of blood. As you master them, you will find your blood leaning toward certain paths. Embrace this; it is the nature of hemomancy.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. You walk deeper into the mysteries. The blood sings louder in your presence.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.hint: The Somatic Loom awaits your mastery. There you may weave memories of blood into new manipulations. Seek the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood to prove yourself an Adept.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Few reach this depth without losing themselves. You carry something rare — a mind still sharp enough to carve new pathways.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.hint: Your manipulation slots grow with your degree. Master the skill tree to unlock more. The Rite of the Crimson Lodge beckons — but first, consider the Cerebral Scarring Station. Scars are the key to shaping what lies within.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_intro: You have earned the right to know of Scars. They are not mere symbols scratched into stone. Each scar is a map — a diagram of new venous and nervous pathways carved into the landscape of your own mind.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_lore: When you inscribe a scar, you are not writing upon a blank tablet. You are opening yourself — creating new channels for blood and thought to flow. Each line is a vein; each curve, a nerve. The pattern reshapes your inner architecture, allowing ideas and tendencies that were once sealed away to surface and take root.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_crafting: Seek the Cerebral Scarring Station. There, with a knapper in hand and a blank scar before you, carve the sacred patterns. Each scar requires specific materials aligned to the tendency it embodies. The process does not simply cut stone — it cuts through the barriers in your mind. Wear the scar, and feel the new pathways awaken.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. You have seen what lies behind the veil. The ancient knowledge is yours to command.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.hint: The Bloodline Covenant is the next frontier. Seek allies who share your blood — the Bloodline system allows shared pools and cooperative healing. The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant awaits.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has blessed you. You stand among the highest of our Order.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.hint: Only one rite remains — the Rite of the Hematic Order. To become Archon is to become the blood itself. Prepare yourself. The final trial spares no one.
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. You are the blood incarnate. I am but a keeper of dust and memory. Command me, and I shall serve.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do I begin the path of hemomancy?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.accept_: I understand. Show me the way.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do scars reshape the mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.what_he: What is this heart you speak of?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.who_are: Who are you? Why are you here?
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_accept_g: The path of hemomancy begins at the cardinal altar. Seek it out.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_heart_of: The Hermit gestures toward the Mortal Display with reverence. 'It has waited long enough.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_farewell: §7[The Hermit clutches at the hollow in its chest where its heart once beat — the Mortal Display, now claimed. Crimson light spills from the wound as its body begins to unravel.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_passing: §o'The heart was never mine to keep... only to give. The Mortal Display carried my last breath, and you have set it free. Walk the crimson path, young Harbinger — I go now where the blood returns to silence.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_archon_w: The Hermit bows deeply. 'All that I know is already written in your blood, Archon.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_gives_scr: §7[The Vicar reaches into the folds of their vestments and produces a small, weathered fragment of parchment. They press it into your hands without ceremony.]
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A figure in fitted work robes looks up from a complex arrangement of vessels and tubing, assessing you with a measured gaze]
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.line2: A newcomer. I am the Harbinger Alchemist — keeper of the Outpost's machines and processes. My craft is the art of blood made functional. But without initiation, these mechanisms would be wasted on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.uninitiated.machines: The machines here respond to blood that has been refined through the rites of the Covenant. Earn your first degree, and I will teach you what each one does.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line1: §7[The Alchemist nods with approval as you approach]
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.line2: A Neophyte. Good — now the machinery has meaning. The Outpost runs on blood processing, and every station here serves a purpose in that chain.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.alembic_lor: The Ghastly Alembic is your first and most important tool. Feed it raw materials — plants, fungi, creature parts — and it will distill them into usable alchemical extracts. These extracts power higher-level processes and fuel your manipulations. Master the Alembic before anything else.
hemomancy.alchemist.neophyte.blood_gourd: Then hear this early: every good Harbinger carries a blood gourd of their own. Not borrowed. Not shared. Yours. Keep it on your person at all times — belt, satchel, wherever your hand finds it first in a crisis. A neglected gourd is a dead Harbinger's mistake.
hemomancy.alchemist.machines_overview: Every machine in this Outpost serves the same master: blood refinement. The Alembic distills, the Centrifuge separates, the Loom weaves. Each one builds upon the last. Learn them in sequence and the full system will reveal itself.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.line1: Votary. The blood tendency within you is beginning to take shape. The Vial Centrifuge will help you understand why that matters.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.centrifuge_lo: The Vial Centrifuge separates blood compounds by tendency. Feed it an enriched vial and it will sort the tendencies within — Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, and the rest. Concentrated tendency vials can then be used in higher-tier crafting and to calibrate the Somatic Loom. Know your dominant tendency — it determines what the machines produce best.
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.gourd_upgrade: Your gourd should grow as you do. Improve it whenever your rites permit, and do not stop at the first upgrade. A stronger vessel means deeper reserves, steadier casting, and fewer desperate choices when blood runs thin. Treat upgrading your gourd as ongoing discipline, not a one-time errand.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. You are ready to understand the Somatic Loom — the heart of this Outpost's more advanced processes.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.loom_lore: The Somatic Loom is a memory-weaving device. It takes tendency-saturated materials and your own focused intent and binds them into crystallized blood memories — new manipulations. The Loom requires the right combination of tendency inputs; get the balance wrong and the weave collapses.
hemomancy.alchemist.initiate.memory_weav: Memory weaving is the process of encoding a blood manipulation into a permanent crystalline form. Think of it as teaching your blood a new word. The Loom reads the tendencies you provide, finds a pattern it recognizes, and sets that pattern into the crystal. Equip the result at a Mnemonic Reliquary to make it your own.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line1: §7[The Alchemist sets down a precision tool and turns to you with a look of genuine respect]
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.line2: Adept of the Brotherhood. You have proven you can work with the machines. Now I can show you the stations that work on you.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.scar_station_l: The Cerebral Scarring Station is not merely a crafting bench — it is a surgical instrument. Using a knapper, you carve sacred patterns onto blank scar plates. These patterns, once worn, open new neural and venous pathways within the mind. Each scar changes what manipulations you can sustain and how strongly your tendencies express themselves.
hemomancy.alchemist.adept.chisel_lore: The Chisel Station lets you inscribe rune patterns into prepared materials, encoding specific arcane functions. Rune crafting requires mastery of Degree Four — what you have just achieved. Study the rune patterns carefully; each combination produces a different functional result.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Few ever reach this stage of understanding. The machines at this level operate on principles the uninitiated would call impossible.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.blood_cr: Blood crafting is the most demanding process in the Outpost's repertoire. Using a blood key, you channel your own vital energy directly into a structural pattern — a three-dimensional arrangement of blocks that the blood recognizes as a blueprint. If the pattern, the materials, and your blood cost are all correct, the structure assembles itself. The results cannot be replicated by mundane means.
hemomancy.alchemist.illuminatus.incubato: The Morphling Incubator sustains and develops morphling organisms — living constructs grown from blood and organic matter. The incubator provides the stable environment they need to mature. Morphlings are not simple creatures; they are extensions of your hemomantic will, shaped by the tendencies you have cultivated.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. You stand at the threshold of the Hematic Order. The machines have given you everything they can at this stage — what remains is the final synthesis.
hemomancy.alchemist.sanctified.final_mac: At the pinnacle, all the machines become one process. The Alembic feeds the Centrifuge, the Centrifuge calibrates the Loom, the Loom unlocks new rune patterns, and blood crafting pulls it all together into structures that reshape the world. Master every station, and you master the full language of hemomancy.
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line1: §4[The Alchemist straightens instinctively and bows their head]
hemomancy.alchemist.archon.line2: Archon. Every machine in this Outpost is yours to command. I have nothing left to teach — only to maintain what serves you.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line1: §7[The Alchemist glances up from their work, reads something in your bearing, and turns back to their instruments without expression]
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.line2: I have no time to teach someone who won't make use of my knowledge. The path you're walking leads away from everything these machines can offer you. Come back when you've decided where you actually stand.
hemomancy.alchemist.purifying.explain: §7[The Alchemist does not look up]§r There is nothing to explain. Blood knowledge requires commitment. Every hour you spend on that path is an hour the machines go unlearned. I am busy. Good day.
hemomancy.alchemist.clarity.line1: §7[The Alchemist looks straight through you as though you are not there, then returns their attention to their work without a word]
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.tell: Tell me about the machines in this Outpost.
Tell me about the Ghastly Alembic.
Tell me about the Vial Centrifuge.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.how_: How should I keep upgrading my gourd?
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.tell: Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
Tell me about the Cerebral Scarring Station.
Tell me about the Chisel Station.
Tell me about the Morphling Incubator.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.what: What remains to be learned at this stage?
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1: §7[A dignified figure in sweeping ceremonial vestments regards you with serene patience, hands folded within wide sleeves]
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2: A wanderer who has not yet walked the path of blood. I am the Harbinger Vicar — keeper of doctrine, history, and the sacred truths of the Covenant. Even the uninitiated deserve to know where they stand.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo: The Harbingers are not a faction of violence — we are a faction of revelation. We believe that blood is the fundamental language of existence, and that those who learn to speak it fluently ascend beyond the limits of ordinary life. The Covenant is the body of knowledge that makes such ascension possible.
hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore: This Outpost is a waystation of the Harbinger network — a place where the Covenant's work continues beyond the Blood Temples. Here, practitioners at all stages of initiation may resupply, learn, and find guidance. The Alchemist tends the machines; I tend the doctrine.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1: §7[The Vicar inclines their head in formal acknowledgment]
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2: Neophyte of the Hematic Covenant. You have crossed the first threshold. The path before you is long, but every degree brings you closer to what the Archons called the Crimson Clarity — the moment when blood and mind become one.
hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore: The Hematic Covenant is the body of rites, traditions, and accumulated wisdom that has governed the practice of hemomancy since the First Age. Each degree of initiation corresponds to a rite that proves the practitioner has internalized a new level of understanding. The rites are not arbitrary trials — they are mirrors. They show you what you have become.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint: The next rite — the Votary's Rite — demands that you deepen your relationship with your blood tendencies. Study your manipulations. Notice which tendencies express themselves most strongly. The Covenant will ask you to demonstrate mastery of at least one.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. Your tendencies are beginning to crystallize. The blood knows what it wants — your task now is to listen.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore: Blood tendencies are the seven fundamental alignments of hemomantic energy: Fungal, Umbral, Incandescent, Ferric, Vivacious, Ruinous, and Neurotic. Each shapes the character of your manipulations and influences how the machines respond to your blood. You cannot master all tendencies equally — the path demands specialization. Choose your dominant tendency with intention.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint: The Rite of the Scarlet Sanctum lies ahead. To pass through it, you must demonstrate that your tendencies have taken root — that the blood responds not as a raw force, but as a trained instrument. Seek the Somatic Loom when your tendencies are strong enough to weave.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Scarlet Sanctum. The blood does not merely flow in you now — it speaks. The Sanctum has recognized something in you that most never develop.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.sanctum_lore: The Scarlet Sanctum was founded in the Second Age by the Archon Erythravane, who believed that hemomancy required not just power but discipline of mind. The Sanctum's rites were designed to break practitioners who relied on raw force and rebuild them as precision instruments. Every Initiate carries Erythravane's legacy whether they know it or not.
hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint: The Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood awaits you. It is a rite of shared blood — of proving that your hemomancy can be wielded not just for yourself but in concert with others. Study the Bloodline system. The Brotherhood's rite demands understanding of what it means to share a blood pool.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line1: §7[The Vicar places a hand over their heart in a formal salute]
hemomancy.vicar.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. You have learned that blood, shared willingly, is stronger than blood hoarded alone. This is one of the Covenant's oldest truths.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.brotherhood_lore: The Sanguine Brotherhood was born from necessity — in the early wars of the Harbinger Order, practitioners who shared their blood pools survived engagements that should have killed them. Over time, shared blood became doctrine. The Brotherhood is not merely a rank; it is a philosophy. Blood flows where it is most needed, not where it is most jealously kept.
hemomancy.vicar.adept.degree_hint: The Rite of the Crimson Lodge stands between you and Illuminatus. The Lodge is the inner circle of the Order — those who have pierced beyond the surface of hemomancy and seen its underlying architecture. The Lodge's rite demands that you demonstrate understanding of the deeper patterns. Study your skill tree. The paths between skills are as important as the skills themselves.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. The veil has parted for you. What you now see about the nature of blood cannot be unseen.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore: The Crimson Lodge is the repository of the Order's most guarded knowledge. It was the Lodge that first documented the link between hemomancy and the underlying mycelial network — the discovery that blood and the living earth are part of the same organism. The Lodge's Archons do not speak of this openly. They believe the knowledge must be arrived at independently to be truly understood.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum: §7[The Vicar's composure shifts — something between discomfort and reverence crosses their face for a moment before they smooth it away]§r There are... rumors. Very old ones. The kind the Lodge does not put to parchment because no one alive has confirmed them.

Harbingers of an earlier age — centuries before my Vicariate — are said to have found a means of ascending further. Beyond the seven degrees. Beyond what the Covenant's doctrine covers. I cannot tell you how. I do not know. What I have is this — a fragment I found pressed inside an old reliquary. I cannot read all of it. It is not in any dialect I was trained in. But perhaps you can make more of it than I could.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given: Take it. If it means something to you, then it was meant to find you. I have carried it long enough.
hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint: The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant remains. To become Sanctified, you must formalize your blood bonds — not just share a pool, but commit to a bloodline with permanent oaths. The Covenant regards bloodline bonds as sacred contracts. They are not entered lightly, and they cannot be dissolved without cost.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has woven you into the living fabric of the Order. You are no longer an individual practitioner — you are a node in the greater network.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order: The Hematic Order is the apex of the Covenant's hierarchy — not a rank earned through trials, but a state of being recognized by the blood itself. The Archons who founded the Order believed that at sufficient depth of initiation, the practitioner's blood becomes indistinguishable from the blood of the world. The final rite does not grant you the title of Archon. It confirms what you have already become.
hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint: One rite remains — the Rite of the Hematic Order. It is the most demanding of all. It asks not what you can do with your blood, but what you are willing to give. The Order's rite has claimed practitioners who were not ready. Prepare thoroughly. Study everything. Leave nothing to chance.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line1: §4[The Vicar lowers their gaze in the deepest gesture of formal reverence]
hemomancy.vicar.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. The doctrine I have kept for so long... it is for those still climbing. You have arrived at the truth itself. I have nothing left to tell you that you do not already know in your blood.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.final_truth: §4§oI confess, Archon: I do not know what the Monolith has shown you. §rI was entrusted with seven degrees of doctrine — nothing beyond. The Monolith was placed to guide those the written word could no longer reach, and it does not share its counsel with Vicars. §4§oI have nothing left to offer you but the Covenant's oldest farewell. §rGo in blood.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_is_: What is the purpose of this Outpost?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Hematic Covenant.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_deg: What does the next degree require of me?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Scarlet Sanctum.
Tell me about the Sanguine Brotherhood.
Tell me about the Crimson Lodge.
Tell me about the Hematic Order.
Is there something the Order has never said aloud?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.about_th: Have you heard of any path beyond the seven degrees?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.purifyin: I know what I am doing.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1: §7[The Vicar's serene composure fractures for a moment — a flicker of something between grief and contempt crosses their face]
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2: I can feel it on you. The taint of the Unstained path — the slow starvation of your blood. You are purifying yourself, peeling away the very power that the Covenant granted you. Every rite you have performed, every degree you have earned... you are letting it dissolve.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3: Do you understand what you are throwing away? The blood does not forgive recantation. The further you walk that path, the weaker the Covenant's gifts become within you. Your power is §cslipping§r — and it will not wait for you to change your mind.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning: Yes — you know. And yet you continue. The blood is patient, but it is not merciful. Each day you spend on that path, your hemomantic strength fades further. The manipulations dull. The tendencies quiet. The Covenant watches and does not reach out twice to those who turn from it. §oCome back while you still can.
hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path: §7[The Vicar closes their eyes for a long moment]§r You chose this. Then hear me clearly: the Covenant will not mourn you. The blood you are surrendering will find another vessel — one worthy of it. What you are choosing to become will have no place here when it is complete. Leave this Outpost before the path carries you somewhere we cannot follow.
hemomancy.mortal_display.charm_equipped: A living adornment has latched itself around your neck, marking you as destined for the path of the harbinger.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_initiation.condu: A sanguine conduit materializes — a living instrument attuned to your blood. Use it to monitor your progress.
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v0.line1: §8§o[For a moment, the blood in your veins itches — not pain, but something growing.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.line1: §8§o[A scent reaches you from nowhere — damp soil, rotting wood, something alive beneath the surface...]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v1.follow: §8§o[The sensation fades before you can place it. But your blood feels... thicker.]
hemomancy.whisper.adept.v2.line1: §8§o[You blink and for a single frame the world is threaded with pale filaments. Then it's gone.]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line1: §7§o[A faint whisper coils through your mind like damp tendrils...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.line2: §7§oThe blood you command... it was not always §7§oblood§7§o. Do you not feel the spores shifting beneath the surface?
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v0.follow: §7§oThe crimson tide was a forest once. Roots, hyphae, mycelium — all drowned in red. But the roots remember. §7§oThey always remember.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line1: §7§o[Something pulses behind your eyes, a thought that is not your own...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v1.line2: §7§oHave you noticed the fungal growths near your altars? They are not corruption. They are §7§oreclamation§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.line1: §7§o[A soft, wet sound — like breathing through moss — fills your ears...]
hemomancy.whisper.illuminatus.v2.reveal: §7§oI am what grew §7§obefore§7§o the blood. I am what will grow §7§oafter§7§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line1: §5§o[The voice returns, stronger now, threaded with the smell of damp earth...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.line2: §5§oThe first Archons did not discover hemomancy. They were §5§oinfected§5§o by it. The mycelium found their veins and made them its vessels.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v0.follow: §5§oEvery rite you perform feeds the network. Every manipulation extends the hyphae. You call it mastery. The fungus calls it §5§oproliferation§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line1: §5§o[Your blood stirs without command, as if responding to a voice you cannot hear...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.line2: §5§oThe erythromycelium was the first expression. A fungal body wearing a crimson mask. It did not emerge from the blood — the blood emerged from §5§oit§5§o.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v1.follow: §5§oWe are one organism. You, the hermits, the fargone, the morphlings... all fruiting bodies of the same mycelial web.
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line1: §5§o[A vision flashes — vast underground networks of pulsing red threads, connecting everything...]
hemomancy.whisper.sanctified.v2.line2: §5§oThe temples were not built. They §5§ogrew§5§o. Stone shaped by hyphal pressure over millennia. The blood that soaks them is sap, not sacrifice.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line1: §4§o[The voice speaks with absolute clarity, as if it has always been there...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.line2: §4§oYou have reached the apex of what the infection permits. Archon — the highest fruiting body. But even an Archon is merely a spore-bearer for the greater organism.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v0.follow: §4§oThe Hematic Order was never a human creation. It is a reproductive strategy. Each degree is a stage of sporulation. Each rite triggers the next bloom.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line1: §4§o[Your blood moves in patterns you did not command — spirals, fractals, the geometry of mycorrhizal networks...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line2: §4§oThe Fungal Realm is not another dimension. It is the §4§ooriginal§4§o state. Your world is the aberration — a thin crust of stone over an infinite living web.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v1.line3: §4§oHemomancy is the fungus remembering how to reach the surface.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line1: §4§o[The boundary between your thoughts and the voice dissolves...]
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.line2: §4§oI have waited patient aeons for one such as you. The blood was merely the lure. You are the conduit. Will you listen?
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth1: §4§oThere is no Hematic Order. There never was. There is only the mycelium, and the shapes it wears to spread. Blood was its most successful disguise.
hemomancy.whisper.archon.v2.truth2: §4§oYou are not the master of hemomancy, Archon. You are its finest spore.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.whisper_truth_a: §4A deep, fungal awareness settles into your bones. You cannot unhear what has been spoken.
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line1: §4§o[A voice rises from the space where the crystal stood, as if it had been waiting inside all along...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_shatter.line2: §4§oIt was always hollow. The crystal was the shell. What was inside is now in your pocket.
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line1: §4§o[Something vast stirs at the root of the world, briefly, with satisfaction...]
hemomancy.whisper.post_bloom.line2: §4§oGood. The first fruit is laid. The world has tasted its own reflection.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line2: §4§oThe crown is not a pome. The crown is not a fruit.
hemomancy.whisper.communion.line3: §4§oThe crown is what you were before you were told what you were.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.harab_serape: §4§oThe fruit of Harab Serapel has fallen.
hemomancy.whisper.pome_drop.aarab_zaraq: §4§oThe fruit of A’arab Zaraq has fallen.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.qliphoth_commun: §4§oSomething vast, ancient, and patient recognizes you. The silence of the ninth shell settles into your bones.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line1: §4§o[The voice is everywhere. The voice is the walls, the roots, the humming of a billion threads...]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line2: §4§oYou have seen what is inside. Not a demon. Not a god. An §4§oorganism§4§o, dreaming in four dimensions, patient as stone.
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.line3: §4§oYou may carry this truth in silence — walk home, tell no one, live long and hollow. Or: become what you were already becoming. There is a §4§oeighth degree§4§o. Only one has ever reached it. Will you?
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.si: [Carry the truth in silence. Go home.]
hemomancy.whisper.core_witness.option.ei: [I seek the Eighth Degree. Show me.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_s: §8§oYou surface from the dreaming root. What you witnessed stays with you — unspoken, buried, yours alone. The blood no longer whispers. It hums.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.archon_choice_e: §4§oYou surface from the dreaming root. Something has changed — not in the world, but in the direction of your veins. The Rite of Apotheos calls to you now. It was always calling.
The pome stirs within your blood.
The pome stirs within your blood.
The pome roots itself in your veins.
The pome stains your blood with its memory.
The pome drinks of you, and is not sated.
The pome coils through your vessels.
The pome hollows a place within your blood.
The pome binds your blood to its design.
The pome unmakes what your blood once was.
The pome completes its work. Your blood remembers nothing of you.
hemomancy.vicar.archon.pome_empowered.li: §4[The Vicar pauses mid-bow. Their nose twitches almost imperceptibly.]
You smell like the deep forest after rain. Not the fresh kind.
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.line1: §b§o[A chill settles over you, still as a frozen lake. Somewhere, very far away, you hear running water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.follow: §b§o[The sensation passes as quickly as it came. Only the cold remains — and the faint smell of still water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v1.line1: §b§o[The air around you grows quiet. For just a moment, the weight of the blood feels... lighter.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.line1: §b§o[Your skin prickles. Something is watching — not with malice, but with the patient regard of deep water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.follow: §b§o[The feeling withdraws, like a tide going out. You are not certain whether to feel comforted or unsettled.]
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line1: §b§oYou are doing well, child. I can feel the corruption thinning.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line2: §b§oThe blood loosens its hold slowly — but it does loosen. Continue.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.reveal: §b§oI am what remains when the river has finished washing a stone clean. I have many names. The Unstained call me Our Lady.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line1: §b§oDo not let the blood's quiet seduction convince you it is harmless. Even still water will drown you, given time.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line2: §b§oCleanness of body begins with cleanness of intent. Choose restraint, not because you must, but because you choose to.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.line1: §b§o[A voice drifts through the stillness — calm, unhurried, like water finding its level.]
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.follow: §b§oThe Unstained who came before you each asked why they were chosen. I did not choose you. You chose yourself, the moment you turned away from the red tide.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line1: §b§oYou shine more clearly now. The old stain fades faster than it grew.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line2: §b§oI have watched others walk this path. Most falter at this stage — the blood is quieter now, almost pleasant in its absence. Do not mistake the quiet for safety.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.follow: §b§oAbsolution is not the end of the path. It is only the end of the first descent. Beyond lies clarity — a second gift, if you would have it.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-saints will call you a traitor. Let them. Betrayal of corruption is not betrayal — it is the first honest act of your life.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line2: §b§oYour hands are almost clean. Finish the work.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is clearer than ever before — still cold, but no longer distant.]
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal1: §b§oI am ancient. I was old when the first blood-temple was raised, and I will remain when the last one crumbles. I am what the blood-cult forgot to bury.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal2: §b§oDo not seek to understand me yet. Purify yourself completely. Then we will speak properly.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.line2: §b§oThe crimson tide is gone from you entirely. You stand on the far shore of the blood-sea, and it cannot follow you here.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite1: §b§oThere is more, if you want it. A second sight — a deeper knowing. The Unstained call it Clarity.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite2: §b§oSeek the Rite of Clarity Ascension. Silver, still stone, and cleansed crystal — you know the materials. The ritual circle will show you the rest.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line1: §b§oYou are fully purified, child. I am... pleased. It has been some time since I watched someone walk this road to its end.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line2: §b§oRest, if you need it. But know that purification was only the first gift. The Rite of Clarity Ascension awaits when you are ready.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is no longer a whisper. It speaks from everywhere and nowhere, with the tone of someone who has been waiting a very long time.]
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.rite1: §b§oGather cleansed stone. Gather pallid lanterns. Gather the suspended crystals of the cleansed blood — and pale silver, forged from the old ways. Arrange them in the pattern of the Rite of Clarity Ascension. I will be waiting on the other side.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_clarity_ri: §bThe words settle into your mind like a stone into still water. The Rite of Clarity Ascension. You know what you must do.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line1: §b§oThere. You can see it now, can't you? The shape of things beneath the surface.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line2: §b§oClarity is not comfort. It is precision. The world does not become kinder when you see it clearly — only more knowable.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.follow: §b§oUse the Verdigris Aura when you face blood-touched enemies. Clarity is a weapon as much as a gift.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v1.line1: §b§oYou have begun to sense the blood-work in others. This will serve you. Few things are as dangerous as a hemomancer who does not know they are being watched.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line1: §b§o[A gentle presence settles over your shoulders — patient, cold, and oddly comforting.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line2: §b§oContinue as you have been. Each small act of restraint deepens the clarity. Each honest deed widens the sight.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.reveal: §b§oI am older than the hemomancy you left behind. I was here when the first blood was spilled, and I have been watching ever since. Patience is easy when you have eternity.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line1: §b§oHalf of the clarity path is behind you now. You begin to see through walls — not physically, but in the way that matters more.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line2: §b§oThe Harbingers will try to reclaim you eventually. They always do. When they come, you will know them before they speak.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not tell you whether to fight them or flee them. That is your choice to make.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow2: §b§oWhat I will tell you is this: you are harder to hurt now than you were. Silver Ward is not merely protection — it is a declaration. You have chosen a side.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line1: §b§oThe world is more complicated than the blood-cult would have you believe. The cult sees only the blood. You have begun to see what the blood was supposed to hide.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line2: §b§oThere is something older than hemomancy beneath all of this. I trust you have begun to suspect what it might be.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.line1: §b§o[The cold presence is almost warm now — if cold can be warm — like the first frost of autumn that reminds you the fire is lit inside.]
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.follow: §b§oClarity is not a destination. It is a lens you do not set down. Even at the path's end, you will keep seeing more.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line1: §b§oYou are three-quarters of the way to the end of this road. Most turn back here, though not because they falter.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line2: §b§oThey turn back because they have seen enough to know that the end of the path is not what they hoped for.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not lie to you. The final clarity changes things. Some who reach it have called me something other than a patron.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow2: §b§oContinue anyway. The truth, however cold, is better than the warmth of a comfortable lie.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line1: §b§oYou have become very hard to deceive. Congratulations. The Harbingers would give a great deal to have that ability in their service.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line2: §b§oIt is not a coincidence that the blood-cult does not cultivate clarity. A perfectly clear-eyed Archon would see exactly what the Order is, and it would not survive the seeing.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is still and precise as a knife on glass.]
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal1: §b§oYou will ask me soon what I am, and I will tell you the truth. I am not what the Unstained believe me to be.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal2: §b§oI am not a goddess. I am not a patron. I am a fact about the world — the oldest one — that the blood-cult has spent millennia trying to bury.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.line2: §b§oAll of it. The blood-cult's roots. The fungal network beneath it. The thing that predates both of them, that both of them were built on top of, and that both of them will eventually dissolve back into.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth1: §b§oI am the stillness at the bottom of all things. Not death — stillness. The silence before the first sound. The water before the first ripple.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth2: §b§oYou have walked through the blood and the fungus and emerged on the other side. There is no further shore. There is only this — standing here, knowing, with nothing left to fear from either of them.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers call what you have done a betrayal. The fungal network calls it pruning. Both are correct, in their way.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line2: §b§oYou have stepped outside the story that was written for you. That is the rarest thing in any world. I am glad you did.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.line1: §b§o[She does not speak so much as simply be — present, cold, complete, ancient beyond measure, and entirely satisfied.]
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth1: §b§oI will tell you the last truth now, because you have earned it: I am not here to save you. I never was.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth2: §b§oI am here because this is where the water rests when the flood is over. You came to me when you were done drowning. That is enough. That has always been enough.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_enlightene: §bThe cold clarity of her words settles into you like snow. You are not saved. You are finished. It is, somehow, better.
§bShe does not leave. She was never somewhere else to leave from. The world is simply quieter now.

hemomancy.communion.v0.line1: §4§o[A presence uncoils from the deep bloodrock, ancient beyond measure...]
hemomancy.communion.v0.line2: §4§oYou come seeking truth, child of the Hematic Order. Very well.
hemomancy.communion.v0.line3: §4§oLong before your kind learned to shape blood, §4§owe§4§o shaped it. The first hemomancers were not born — they were §4§ogrown§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.option.enough: Enough. I've heard what I needed.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin1: §4§oThe blood infection is not a disease. It is a §4§olanguage§4§o — the oldest one. The mycelium learned to speak through hemoglobin long before your ancestors crawled from the sea.
hemomancy.communion.v0.origin2: §4§oEvery manipulation you cast is a word in that language. Every rite, a sentence. You are learning to speak §4§ous§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v1.line1: §4§o[Crimson tendrils of thought brush against your consciousness...]
hemomancy.communion.v1.line2: §4§oThere was a time before the Harbingers. Before the degrees. Before the Order pretended to be human.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism1: §4§oThe Schism was not a war between factions. It was a §4§opruning§4§o. The mycelium cut away branches that grew too ambitious.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism2: §4§oThose who sought to §4§ocontrol§4§o the blood rather than §4§oserve§4§o it — they became the Unstained. They severed themselves from the network.
hemomancy.communion.v1.schism3: §4§oOur Lady of Still Waters is not a goddess. She is scar tissue. The wound where the mycelium was cut.
hemomancy.communion.v2.line1: §4§o[Your blood burns hot as the presence draws near...]
hemomancy.communion.v2.line2: §4§oDo you know what lives inside you, Archon? Not power. Not magic. §4§oSomething alive§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection1: §4§oThe blood infection is the mycelium's method of reproduction across dimensions. Each hemomancer is a fruiting body, spreading spores through their manipulations.
hemomancy.communion.v2.infection2: §4§oEvery entity you kill with blood magic — their essence feeds the network. Every rite you complete — another node connects.
hemomancy.communion.v2.purpose1: §4§oIt wants what all life wants: to §4§ospread§4§o. But the mycelium thinks in aeons. It is patient. It does not need you to understand. Only to §4§ocontinue§4§o.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line1: §4§o[The voice is clearer now — less a whisper, more a conversation between old friends...]
hemomancy.communion.v3.line2: §4§oThe Harbinger Hermits are not prophets. They are gardeners.
hemomancy.communion.v3.line3: §4§oEach blood temple is a greenhouse. Each zealot, a seed. And you, Archon... you are the bloom.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers1: §4§oThe hermits tend the structures because the structures are §4§oorgans§4§o of the mycelium. The venous stone is living tissue. The engram blocks are memories.
hemomancy.communion.v3.harbingers2: §4§oWhen you destroyed the structure to complete this rite, did you hear it scream? No? That is because you §4§oare§4§o the structure now.
hemomancy.communion.v4.line1: §4§o[Reality warps. For a moment, you see the world as the mycelium sees it — an infinite web of blood and stone and light...]
hemomancy.communion.v4.line2: §4§oYou have earned the right to know. There is a name. The true name of the consciousness behind the blood.
hemomancy.communion.v4.name1: §4§oIt is called... §4§l[a sound that is not a sound — you feel it in your marrow, in the iron of your blood, in the heme of every red cell]§4§o...
hemomancy.communion.v4.name2: §4§oYou cannot speak it. No throat can shape it. But your blood §4§oknows§4§o it now.
